newsitem.title: JORDAN: Chirac leaves Jordan for Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Chirac leaves Jordan for Lebanon.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac left Jordan on Thursday after a 24-hour visit in which he expressed anxiety about the faltering Middle East peace process.

King Hussein saw Chirac off at Amman's Marka airport as the French leader left for Lebanon on the latest stage of a Middle East tour. Chirac used his stay in Jordan to call for greater understanding between Islam and the West and urge the speedy implementation of an oil-for-food deal in Iraq.
